ops.text: Vendor shall defend and indemnify Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Customer shall indemnify Vendor from and against any third-party claim to the extent arising out of content or materials provided by Customer for use in the Services or Customer's breach of Applicable Law. The indemnified party shall give the indemnifying party prompt written notice of the claim, allow the indemnifying party to control the defence, and provide reasonable cooperation at the indemnifying party's expense.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no indemnification article even though Sections 9.3, 21.3 and 30.5 assume one exists, so we inserted Section 20 after the final Warranties paragraph. It gives Vendor's defence and indemnity of Customer and its Affiliates for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data breaches and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with a notice, control and cooperation procedure, and keeps Customer's indemnity narrow (Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of Applicable Law).
proposal.summary: Insert Section 20 with Vendor's defence/indemnity of Customer and Affiliates for IP, breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, standard procedure, and a narrow Customer indemnity.
